idea-plugin.name: Periwinkle Islands Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A light JetBrains theme that pairs the soft periwinkle chrome of the classic Visual Studio Blue theme with deep purple accents: purple-tinted focused tabs, purple selection text and purple keywords.

  • Chrome colours are inspired by the Visual Studio 2019/2022 Blue theme.
  • A calm editor palette in clearly separated colours: violet keywords, blue types, amber methods, red strings and green comments, with names in plain text, as in Visual Studio.
  • Every text colour is checked for contrast when the theme is built.

Requires JetBrains IDEs 2026.2 or later with the Islands UI.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft or JetBrains. Visual Studio is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation; Rider is a trademark of JetBrains s.r.o.

Shared semantic colours for C#, Java, Kotlin, Go and Python, with this theme's own palette and clearly separated panels.
